newsitem.title: USA: Delta names new finance division execs.
newsitem.headline: Delta names new finance division execs.

text.p: Delta Air Lines Inc said Wednesday it has named Edward West vice president, financial planning and analysis, and Hiram Cox corporate controller in the company's finance unit.
The finance unit is being realigned into three parts, all reporting to senior vice president and chief financial officer Tom Roeck, the company said.
In addition to the positions named Wednesday, Delta said it expects to name a new treasurer soon. West and Cox will divide the treasurer's duties until a person is named to the job.
